steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and formal project management education—but no work experience. Many Lancaster professionals new to project management discover this flexibility opens the door earlier than expected.

steps_items.heading: Apply to PMI and Pay Exam Fee
steps_items.text: Once coursework is complete, submit your PMI application and exam registration. Our team guides you through the documentation process to ensure your eligibility is confirmed. PMI will verify your educational requirement before you can sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-preparation resources to help you succeed on test day. You'll sit for a proctored exam that validates your mastery of project management fundamentals. We support your readiness every step of the way.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential Long-Term
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew on a three-year cycle. You'll earn professional development units through continued learning and involvement in project management. Staying current keeps your credential active and demonstrates your commitment to the profession.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
